lines.beaver: 민준 씨, 이 마을은 뭐로 유명해요?
lines.beaver_en: Minjun, what is this village famous for?
lines.beaver_roman: Minjun ssi, i maeureun mworo yumyeonghaeyo?
lines.learner: 여기는 한옥으로 유명해요. 집이 다 예뻐요.
lines.en: It's famous for hanok. All the houses are pretty.
lines.roman: Yeogineun hanogeuro yumyeonghaeyo. Jibi da yeppeoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Wow, it's really nice. What else is there to see?
lines.learner: 저 위에 오래된 절이 있어요. 경치가 좋기로 유명해요.
lines.en: There's an old temple up there. It's famous for its great view.
lines.roman: Jeo wie oraedoen jeori isseoyo. Gyeongchiga jokiro yumyeonghaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: What do people do at the temple?
lines.learner: 스님들이 기도하고 공부해요. 조용히 구경해야 해요.
lines.en: The monks pray and study. We have to look around quietly.
lines.roman: Seunimdeuri gidohago gongbuhaeyo. Joyonghi gugyeonghaeya haeyo.

lines.learner: 저건 교회예요. 백 년 전에 지었어요.
lines.en: That's a church. It was built 100 years ago.
lines.roman: Jeogeon gyohoeyeyo. Baeng nyeon jeone jieosseoyo.

lines.beaver_en: Every house has a Korean flag!
lines.en: Yes, today is Independence Movement Day, so they hung flags.

lines.beaver_en: What about holidays? Are there many people?
lines.learner: 네, 설날에 민속놀이를 해서 사람이 많아요.
lines.en: Yes, there are lots of people because of folk games on Lunar New Year.
lines.roman: Ne, seollare minsongnorireul haeseo sarami manayo.

lines.beaver_en: What folk games do they play?
lines.learner: 윷놀이를 해요. 꼭 같이 해 보세요.
lines.en: They play yut. You should definitely try it with us.
lines.roman: Yunnorireul haeyo. Kkok gachi hae boseyo.

lines.beaver_en: Great! What else do they do on holidays?
lines.en: They hold an ancestral rite in the morning. It's an important tradition.

lines.beaver: 문화와 전통에 대해 더 이야기해 볼래요?
lines.beaver_en: Can you tell me more about culture and tradition?
lines.beaver_roman: Munhwawa jeontonge daehae deo iyagihae bollaeyo?
lines.en: Korea has zodiac signs. I'm a Tiger.

lines.beaver: 재미있네요. 저는 무슨 띠인지 확인해 볼게요.
lines.beaver_en: Interesting. I'll check which sign I am.
lines.beaver_roman: Jaemiinneyo. Jeoneun museun ttiinji hwaginhae bolkkeyo.
lines.learner: 좋아요. 이제 한옥 카페에서 차 마셔요.
lines.en: Sounds good. Now let's have tea at a hanok café.
lines.roman: Joayo. Ije hanok kapeeseo cha masyeoyo.
